name: Chart markers
description: Bravo trade markers on the candle chart: ENTRY/SELL arrows, READY, running P/L, PEAKED/PAUSED and SKIPPED receipts, plus BREAK markers from the breakout-watch component.
_comment: Lightweight Charts marker options. position: aboveBar|belowBar|inBar. shape: arrowUp|arrowDown|circle|square. size: 0.5-2 recommended. Each marker type has its own display flag.

pending.label: READY
pending._comment: Signal armed — waiting for a positive candle to confirm the fill.

gatedExit.label: X
gatedExit._comment: Marks where a suppressed (NO-TRADE) position would have exited; text shows the hypothetical result. PEAKED/PAUSED receipts read SKIPPED in skippedColor, since green/red are reserved for real results.

spikeEntry._comment: Warns on suspicious BUY entry shapes, labeled by expectation: 'over' when the entry close is >dipPct below the highest close of the prior peakCandles (the move already ran — historically ~-$19 avg, gated by lateEntryGate), 'risky' when >=minShare of the move arrived in the final tailCandles (high variance, ~-$10 avg). Tagged markers use warningColor so a risky entry is visually distinct from a clean one.
